protocol_status: frozen_after_P3_results; exploratory follow-up, not independent preregistration
filter: same fourth-order Butterworth zero-phase run-level filter on 22 EEG and 3 EOG channels

eog_correction.type: pooled linear regression from 3 EOG channels to 22 EEG channels
eog_correction.training_data: only expert-clean epochs from eight source subjects, per LOSO fold
eog_correction.target_use: apply frozen coefficients to synchronous target EOG, no target fit or labels

primary_test_population: identical expert-clean trial IDs for both conditions
split: 9-fold LOSO, both target sessions held out
primary_metric: per-target-subject balanced accuracy; corrected minus uncorrected paired difference
secondary_qc: source and target EEG-EOG absolute cross-correlation and correction RMS ratio
limitations: The corrected pipeline requires three EOG sensors and is not pure EEG-only.
Reduced EOG correlation does not prove that only ocular interference was removed; neural signal can also be attenuated.
Official expert artifact flags do not label artifact types.
Zero-phase filtering and expert-clean test condition are offline-only.
No target-subject observations are used to estimate correction coefficients.
